protocol.hypothesis: The already-computed independent diagnostic embedding can recover an explicitly hidden stored conclusion when both the task and memory overflow the encoder window.

trial.description: Retain the successful diagnostic vector and search conclusion vectors after all incumbent retrieval stages; no extra inference, reindex, model change, threshold change or full-pool eviction.

protocol.selection: Run development, unit contracts and historical development regressions before reserved scoring. Require gains with no delivered fact/rank loss, negative ID/order change, scope/trust/tag/visibility or packet violation. The reserved incidents were already exposed; no blind claim. Reject and restore if either split fails guards.
guards: Preserve all historical outcomes, including earlier conclusion gains and capacity-infeasible retention cases.
Cache a diagnostic only after its original head-vector search succeeds; supplementary failures preserve incumbents.
Keep original conclusion matches ahead of newly supplied diagnostic-conclusion matches.
No arbitrary single-paragraph suffixes or claimed precision gains.
protocol.registration_serialization: JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) plus a final newline

decision: Ship diagnostic-conclusion reuse. Two development answers gained; reserved recall unchanged. No observed delivery/rank, negative-identity, scope or budget regression. No generalization or precision gain claimed.

regression.timing_note: Concurrent test and compilation activity; no latency benchmark.

validation.fixture_audit: case IDs, source mappings, split counts, source/evaluator/executable and frozen input hashes verified
